overview_description.description: iStoria is an English learning app that uses a graded reader strategy to encourage users to keep learning. It helps learners in gaining over 400 English words per month and making their learning journey in order to master english professionally in less than 6 months. They use academic and certified learning strategies and smart alerts to track your progress.

product.name: iStoria English Learning App
product.description: A mobile application that helps users improve their English language skills through reading graded Oxford stories, listening, and interactive vocabulary exercises.

product.name: Level Placement Test
product.description: An assessment tool within the app that evaluates users' English proficiency to place them at the appropriate learning level.

product.name: Vocabulary Learning System
product.description: An interactive system that helps users learn and master English vocabulary through flashcards, quizzes, and spaced repetition.

product.name: Family Subscription Plan
product.description: A subscription option allowing up to six family members to access iStoria's learning content with individual accounts under one plan.
